Generated by
<repo>/.github/skills/dxc-issue-triage/data/issues/4341/measure-release-matrix.py

repro.hlsl              declares float4 operator[](int) on a struct and
                        writes through it: `m[0] = 9.0;`
variant-getter-read.hlsl same struct, subscript READ instead of written
